industries.agriculture.description: Farm robots and drones: precision spraying, fieldwork, crop monitoring, grounds care. Savings on crop protection products and labor. Estimate the impact.
industries.agriculture.name: Agriculture
industries.agriculture.lead: Seasonal workers are scarcer, yet fields must still be treated on time. Agricultural drones and field robots do it more precisely and faster than people.
industries.agriculture.lead2: They spray exactly where needed, save crop protection products and give you an objective picture of the field, especially where manual work can’t keep up.
